title: Promoting AI Literacy in Higher Education: Evaluating the IEC-V1 Chatbot for Personalized Learning and Educational Equity
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and usability testing of a chatbot prototype (IEC-V1) designed for educational settings. While it mentions societal goals like educational equity and the Sustainable Development Goals as motivations, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
